findings.title: The regression test does not exercise the guarded subgroup-count lookup
findings.body: This call requests a brief group listing (`true` is `briefRepresentation`) and does not request `subGroupsCount`; the subgroup-count lookup is a separate, conditional operation. As a result, the test does not exercise the changed `GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount()` null guard. It also has no start barrier or join, so deletion can finish before the reader runs, or the assertion can run before an in-flight read records its exception. Request subgroup counts and synchronize with the reader so the test verifies the fix.

findings.title: A failed deletion can leave the reader thread looping indefinitely
findings.body: If any group deletion throws, control exits the `forEach` before `deletedAll` is set. The reader catches request exceptions and continues looping while that flag is false, so the background thread can keep issuing requests indefinitely and prevent the test JVM from shutting down. Set the flag in a `finally` block and wait for the reader thread to terminate.
